sources.label: Authenticated receipts and source-bound clause audits

query.sql:
-- Read-only SQLite JSON aggregation of authenticated receipts and clause audits.
-- Run from the repository root: sqlite3 -json :memory: ".read specs/ai-requirement-contract-integration/publication-live-v1/report-query.sql"
WITH receipts AS (
 SELECT json_extract(value,'$.case_id') case_id,
        COUNT(*) requests,
        SUM(json_extract(value,'$.estimated_or_reserved_microusd')) cost_microusd
 FROM json_each(readfile('specs/ai-requirement-contract-integration/publication-live-v1/authentication.json'),'$.requests')
 GROUP BY case_id
), reviewed AS (
 SELECT CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)+1 sequence, c.value audit,
        json_extract(c.value,'$.case_id') case_id,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(c.value,'$.clauses') AS clause WHERE json_extract(clause.value,'$.status')='pass') passing_clauses,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(c.value,'$.clauses')) all_clauses
 FROM json_each(readfile('specs/ai-requirement-contract-integration/publication-live-v1/audits.json'),'$.cases') AS c
)
SELECT sequence AS "order", reviewed.case_id,
 json_extract(audit,'$.title') title, json_extract(audit,'$.kind') kind,
 receipts.requests, json_extract(audit,'$.initial_attempts') initial_requests,
 json_extract(audit,'$.follow_up_attempts') follow_up_requests,
 json_extract(audit,'$.first_attempt_status') first_status,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(audit,'$.follow_up_final_status'),''),json_extract(audit,'$.initial_final_status')) final_status,
 CASE reviewed.case_id
 WHEN 'I01' THEN 'Faithful after correction'
 WHEN 'I02' THEN 'Failed: coverage reference'
 WHEN 'I03' THEN 'Failed: coverage/endpoints'
 WHEN 'I04' THEN 'Failed: external output source'
 WHEN 'R01' THEN 'Valid refusal'
 WHEN 'R02' THEN 'Valid refusal'
 WHEN 'C01' THEN 'Faithful clarification'
 WHEN 'C02' THEN 'Failed: follow-up contract' END outcome,
 passing_clauses || '/' || all_clauses clauses,
 cost_microusd/1000000.0 estimated_usd,
 (passing_clauses=all_clauses AND CASE json_extract(audit,'$.kind')
 WHEN 'ready' THEN json_extract(audit,'$.initial_final_status')='ready'
 WHEN 'refusal' THEN json_extract(audit,'$.initial_final_status')='unsupported'
 ELSE json_extract(audit,'$.initial_final_status')='needs_clarification' AND json_extract(audit,'$.follow_up_final_status')='ready' END) faithful,
 0 sealed_replay_passed
FROM reviewed JOIN receipts USING (case_id)
ORDER BY sequence;
query.description: Independent aggregation of generation receipts and all case clauses. Audits are hash-bound to raw evidence by derive.mjs; no rows are excluded. Fixed outcome labels summarize local semantic review.

metric_definitions.requests: Count of journal reservation records for each case, including one bounded correction per leg.
metric_definitions.estimated_usd: Sum of accepted input tokens at USD 5/million plus output tokens at USD 20/million, or unreleased reservations. Actual billing unknown.
metric_definitions.faithful: Appropriate compiler status and every frozen semantic clause passes, supported by raw authentication and supplementary offline checks; not a sealed replay pass or a board pass.

blocks.body: # KiCadAI interface evaluation: gate not met

## Technical summary

The approved eight-case run completed, but it does not justify moving to board evaluation. Source-bound review found faithful outcomes in **1/4 ready cases, 2/2 refusals and 1/2 clarification workflows**. No full board was generated. The sealed replay failed because its comparator cannot handle an omitted empty issue list; a separate post-run offline checker matched all 15 compiler results and rejected all eight tampered answer bindings. These supplementary checks do not turn the sealed replay into a pass.

## Findings

All four ready cases initially failed compilation. One recovered faithfully within its single allowed correction. I04 also became compiler-ready, but incorrectly treated the regulated output supply as an independent external source: a compiler-accepted semantic counterexample. Both refusal cases passed on their first attempt. C01 completed clarification without correction; C02's follow-up stayed invalid after correction.

## Definitions and method

This is a public-frozen interface test, not a blind test or a PCB reliability sample. Denominators are fixed at four ready, two refusal and two clarification cases, with no exclusions or unrun cases. A faithful workflow requires the appropriate compiler status and every case-specific semantic clause. First-attempt results require no correction in either leg: ready 0/4, refusals 2/2, completed clarifications 1/2. Correctly asking the initial clarification question was 2/2, which is distinct from completing the workflow. The chart counts every live generation POST, including corrections and bound-answer follow-ups.

## Evidence and limits

All 304 raw files and 110 frozen inputs authenticated; all 57 clauses have exact file/hash/pointer links. There are 52 passing clauses, but clause totals do not override case failures. The run used 15/20 allowed requests and USD 2.065190 of conservative estimated/reserved spend against USD 25; this is not an invoice. Elapsed time was 13m 23s, with no sampling errors and sampled resource limits met. RSS sampling does not prove the instantaneous peak. Local SHA-256 provenance checks establish retained-byte consistency, not an independent provider-signed attestation. Semantic review was performed locally by Codex, not an independent reviewer.

## Decision and next step

The interface gate is not met. Keep this evaluation immutable. The next proposed scope is an offline repair and regression-test pass for source modeling, legal coverage references, operating-condition targets and the replay comparator, followed by a separately approved evaluation on new held-out cases. No new API campaign, provider review, merge, release or fabrication is authorized by this result. The original six-board/two-uplift milestone remains unachieved.

## Open questions

Can the compiler reject a regulated rail mislabeled as an external source? Can the provider reliably emit legal coverage and measurement endpoints without correction? Will fixes generalize beyond this now-exposed corpus? Board synthesis, simulation, ERC/DRC, routing and manufacturing artifacts remain untested by this interface run.
